title: Nec and non plus ultra
html_source: Interestingly, necnon is a double negative in Latin, and thus ends up being positive. Ne plus ultra, non plus ultra, and nec plus ultra all have the equivalent meaning (viz. “nothing more beyond”, in the sense of being superlative).
